Alex Reed: I saw a short-let advert for Flat 2, 94 Example Mews, London W12 8QT. Is this offer another holiday booking?
Rowan Pike: That was last year. Mira Vale now offers the ordinary periodic tenancy in your draft; I am Rowan Pike, their authorised managing agent.
Alex Reed: Why is GBP 600 lower than the other rooms I saw?
Rowan Pike: The room is smaller and overlooks the railway. You can inspect it on 15 November 2026 at 16:00; no payment is required before the viewing.

Tenancy agreement
Property: Flat 2, 94 Example Mews, London W12 8QT
Landlord: Mira Vale
Letting representative: Rowan Pike, acting for Northbank Example Lettings Ltd.
Rent: GBP 600 per calendar month.
Tenancy deposit: GBP 690.
The tenancy is periodic from 1 December 2026.
The tenant may end the tenancy with two months' written notice.
No administration fee is payable.
The landlord is responsible for structural and heating repairs, except tenant-caused damage.
This offer is an ordinary periodic tenancy; earlier holiday bookings are not part of this agreement.
